issue.title: feat: show active mint name and balance on POS screen
issue.body: Fixes #287 - cashiers had no way to see which mint was active without navigating to Settings. Adds a discreet info bar below the top nav showing the active mint name and current BTC balance. Updates automatically when returning from Settings via refreshDisplay().

comment.body:
Good question. The use case is cashiers at busy merchant setups where multiple mints might be configured — without seeing the active mint on the POS screen, they have to navigate to Settings to verify which mint is active before charging. This creates unnecessary friction during transactions.

The info bar is discreet (small text, 13sp) and only visible when a mint is configured. It hides automatically when no mint is set. If the consensus is that this belongs elsewhere (e.g., a status bar or settings header), happy to move it.

release.name: Release v1.5
release.body:
# Numo v1.5 🚀
We are excited to announce Numo v1.5! This release is largely built on direct feedback from merchants using Numo on the ground. We are incredibly grateful for your input and will keep listening as we continue to improve. This update focuses heavily on reliability, user experience enhancements, and expanding our support worldwide. 

Here are the major highlights for this update:

### NFC & Payment Reliability
* **Rock Solid NFC:** We've implemented major stability fixes for Tap2Pay. NFC transactions will no longer fail after retries or when resuming the app from the background, ensuring a smooth checkout experience every time.
* **Network Safety Trigger:** Numo now intelligently checks for active internet connectivity. If you're offline, the app will prevent the generation of payment requests to save you and your customers from failed transactions.

### Enhanced History & Analytics
* **Sales Summary:** Gain better insights into your business! A brand new Sales Summary dashboard is now accessible directly from your transaction history.
* **Advanced History Filters:** Easily navigate your past payments with a new expandable filter bar. You can now filter transactions by `Settled` or `Pending` statuses and apply **Custom Date Ranges**.
* **Unified Details & Receipts:** We've merged the receipt screen directly into the transaction details, offering a much cleaner and more seamless experience when reviewing past payments.

### Better Customization
* **Default Payment Methods:** You can now configure your preferred default payment method in the app settings, allowing you to get paid exactly how you want, faster.

### Global Currency & Localization
* **Reliable Exchange Rates via Yadio.io:** We've switched our fiat exchange rate provider from Coinbase to Yadio.io. This change is especially important for LATAM currencies, providing more reliable data and preventing blockages in countries where Coinbase is blacklisted.
* **New Languages:** Numo now fully supports **Korean** and **Japanese** translations! 🇰🇷🇯🇵

---

## 🛠️ Full Changelog

* feat: Implement network safety trigger for charge buttons and history by @a1denvalu3 in https://github.com/cashubtc/Numo/pull/282
* feat: check mint limits before enabling Charge button by @Delgado74 in https://github.com/cashubtc/Numo/pull/283
* Fix 'Starting wallet...' flash when returning to POS screen by @a1denvalu3 in https://github.com/cashubtc/Numo/pull/284
* feat: add Korean and Japanese translations by @a1denvalu3 in https://github.com/cashubtc/Numo/pull/251
* Fix HCE interruption on backgrounding and retry by @a1denvalu3 in https://github.com/cashubtc/Numo/pull/289
* fix: apply edge-to-edge window insets in TransactionDetailActivity by @a1denvalu3 in https://github.com/cashubtc/Numo/pull/295
* Fix: Optimize mint limits refresh by @a1denvalu3 in https://github.com/cashubtc/Numo/pull/296
* feat: Add Default Payment Method preference by @a1denvalu3 in https://github.com/cashubtc/Numo/pull/297
* feat: Add expandable filter bar to History Activity by @a1denvalu3 in https://github.com/cashubtc/Numo/pull/298
* Change transaction history default filter to 'All' by @a1denvalu3 in https://github.com/cashubtc/Numo/pull/303
* Feat/sales summary by @swedishfrenchpress in https://github.com/cashubtc/Numo/pull/302
* Merge receipt screen into transaction details by @a1denvalu3 in https://github.com/cashubtc/Numo/pull/305

issue.title: feat: migrate LATAM currencies to Yadio API
issue.body:
## Summary
- Defined a set of LATAM currencies (`ARS`, `BOB`, `BRL`, `CLP`, `COP`, `CRC`, `CUP`, `DOP`, `GTQ`, `HNL`, `MLC`, `MXN`, `NIO`, `PAB`, `PEN`, `PYG`, `UYU`, `VES`) to explicitly fall back to the Yadio API instead of Coinbase.
- Modified the Coinbase API parsing/routing in `CurrencyManager` to correctly use Yadio for these LATAM currencies.
- Ensured these currencies appear in the settings page (CurrencySettingsActivity) without depending on Coinbase API's supported currencies endpoints, to circumvent blacklisting issues.
- Included corresponding tests to verify routing and mapping.

issue.title: Problem with exchange rates for Cuban currencies (CUP/CUC/MLC) using Coinbase API
issue.body:
## Problem

When using Coinbase as the source for fiat exchange rates, the following issues arise with Cuban currencies:

1. **Incorrect CUP (Cuban Peso) rate**: Coinbase shows an exchange rate that does not reflect the real market value of CUP, resulting in an incorrect rate for Cuban users.

2. **Obsolete CUC currency instead of MLC**: Coinbase still lists CUC (Cuban Convertible Peso), a currency that ceased to exist officially in 2021. The current currency is MLC (Freely Convertible Currency), while CUP remains the main circulating currency.

## Proposed Solution

**Yadio.io** is an API developed by a Cuban developer that provides:
- Correct and up-to-date exchange rates for CUP
- MLC currency instead of CUC (non-existent currency)
- Regular updates to reflect changes in the Cuban monetary system
- Exchange rates for other currencies remain equivalent to Coinbase and other reference APIs

### Benefits
- Accurate exchange rates for users in Cuba
- Updated currencies according to the current monetary system
- Actively maintained API by the Cuban community

Would you be open to including Yadio.io as an alternative source for fiat exchange rates, allowing users to select between multiple rate providers?
